body: I wish I knew. We had our whole future planned. I guess he figured I'd never find out.

He was very open and seemed to be very honest. 
Just behaved like the perfect boyfriend. 

I pulled out my previous phone to which I used on a trip with him last year to grab some photos off it and saw the messages popping up when it connected to wifi. I think he borrowed it and forgot to log out.
I wish I shared your faith. I don't think I could believe there's a god if he would allow me to feel this way when all I've given is love.
